description: This 3D bar chart, from the paper "Are Large Language Models Really Good Logical Reasoners: A Comprehensive Evaluation and Beyond," illustrates the accuracy of three large language models—Davinci-03, ChatGPT, and BARD—across two distinct tasks: "Classification" and "Generation." The horizontal axis represents the model names (Davinci-03, ChatGPT, BARD), while the vertical axis represents the "Accuracy" metric, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The depth axis represents the two tasks, "Classification" and "Generation," with "Classification" positioned at the front and "Generation" at the back. Each model has two bars, one for each task, arranged side-by-side along the model axis. The bars are colored with a gradient from blue (lower values) to yellow (higher values), visually indicating their accuracy levels. The bar for Davinci-03 in the "Classification" task reaches approximately 0.55 accuracy, while its "Generation" bar is slightly lower, around 0.50. ChatGPT's "Classification" bar is the tallest, reaching approximately 0.80, and its "Generation" bar is also high, around 0.70. BARD's "Classification" bar is the shortest, at approximately 0.25, while its "Generation" bar is slightly higher, around 0.30. The bars are not sorted by height, and no bars are visually emphasized with special formatting.
